builds.name: Reference: AP dive
builds.goal: Reference for Evelynn: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A stealth pick assassin who waits for a prepared charm, bursts a target and retreats to regenerate or reset her approach. Measure prepared Charm, target MR and R execute threshold. A sustained-health route must justify staying revealed and losing normal regeneration/reset opportunities. AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window.
builds.summary: AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window.
testPlan: Kit question for Evelynn: Measure prepared Charm, target MR and R execute threshold. A sustained-health route must justify staying revealed and losing normal regeneration/reset opportunities.

Start with the early core (Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP, penetration and Rocketbelt access test a short committed damage window. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Evelynn strikes out with her Lasher, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can shoot a line of spikes at nearby foes a few times. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: The active cannot replace every mobility tool; minimal sustained durability.

The route fails Evelynn's stated kit question: Measure prepared Charm, target MR and R execute threshold. A sustained-health route must justify staying revealed and losing normal regeneration/reset opportunities.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: The active cannot replace every mobility tool; minimal sustained durability.
Full cost 16,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Evelynn strikes with her Lasher, dealing [25 / 30 / 35 / 40 / 45 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy hit and causing Evelynn's next 3 Attacks or Abilities on that unit to deal an additional [15 / 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage. Evelynn can Recast this Ability up to [3] times.

Recast: Evelynn fires spikes through the nearest enemy, dealing [25 / 30 / 35 / 40 / 45 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage to all enemies hit.

Evelynn marks a champion or monster for 5 seconds. If Evelynn hits the target with an Attack or Ability, she will expunge the mark, refund its cost, and Slow the target by [45]% for [0.75] seconds.

If the mark lasts at least 2.5 seconds, expunging it has extra effects:Against champions: Charms them for [1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25] second(s) and removes [(0.35 / 0.375 / 0.4 / 0.425 / 0.45) × 100]% Magic Resist for [4] seconds.Against monsters: Charms them for [3 / 3.25 / 3.5 / 3.75 / 4] seconds and deals [250 / 300 / 350 / 400 / 450 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage.

Evelynn unleashes her demonic energy, dealing heavy damage, becoming Untargetable and teleporting backwards. She deals [125 / 250 / 375 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage, increased to [(125 / 250 / 375 + (0.75) × AP) × (2.4)] against enemies below 30% Health. Upon cast, set Demon Shade to a 1.25 second cooldown.

Evelynn enshrouds herself in her Demon Shade after [4] seconds of not Attacking or using Abilities. Demon Shade restores [characterLevelInterpolation(15 → 150; raw flags preserved)] Health per second while below [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=250, perLevel=20, changes=[]) + (2.5) × AP] Health. From level 6 onward, it also grants Camouflage.

Taking damage from champions or towers removes Demon Shade for [1.5] seconds.

Evelynn whips an enemy, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180] plus [(3 + (0.015) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage. Evelynn gains [(0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5) × 100]% Move Speed for [2] seconds.

Entering Demon Shade refreshes this Ability's cooldown and empowers it. When this Ability is empowered, Evelynn dashes to the target and deals [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240] plus [(4 + (0.025) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage to her target and everyone she passes through instead.

builds.name: Shade-reset whiplash skirmisher
builds.summary: Re-enter Shade to refresh empowered Whiplash instead of committing once.
builds.goal: Re-enter Shade to refresh empowered Whiplash instead of committing once.
builds.hypothesis: Demon Shade activates after four seconds without attacks/casts and empowered E refreshes through entering Shade. Whiplash has AP-based percent-max-health magic damage and a dash; Dusk and Dawn rewards an actual attack after the reset and Gunblade slows for the follow-up. Riftmaker is experimental because disengaging can sacrifice its combat ramp.
testPlan: Required state: Need a safe disengage, level-six camouflage and another empowered E target.
Time a retreat and second empowered E, logging Shade timing and healing threshold with fixed AP.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Reveal effects, damage or forced combat prevent Shade; sustained items lose immediate assassination power.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: E's refreshed state is not an unrestricted reset while Evelynn keeps attacking.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Gunblade, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Execute threshold AP dive
builds.summary: Push targets across the two separate finishing thresholds.
builds.goal: Push targets across the two separate finishing thresholds.
builds.hypothesis: Allure after 2.5 seconds removes 35-45% MR, and Q's marked-target bonuses plus E percent health can prepare Last Caress. R's 0.75 AP damage multiplies by 2.4 below 30% health; Shadowflame boosts magic damage below 40%. Rocketbelt improves access, and Banshee helps protect the initial approach.
testPlan: Required state: Need full charm preparation and health below 30% before R damage resolves.
Measure R at 29%, 31% and 41% target health with the same MR and AP.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Telegraphing W permits escape; shields or mistimed R produce the weaker damage case.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Shadowflame's 40% threshold does not by itself activate R's separate 30% multiplier.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Rocketbelt, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
